partnership_angle: Referral partner + validator, with design-partner potential. Decrypt is exactly the target profile: a 2023-founded, ~12-person founder-led Silicon Valley firm auditing high-growth B2B SaaS/cloud-native startups (the same companies LoxeAI targets), and it already embraces automation by working alongside Vanta and Drata client stacks. Because it competes on speed ('certified 50% faster'), a pre-audit AWS readiness scan that makes clients arrive audit-ready directly reinforces its core pitch. Raymond Cheng is technically deep (CISSP, CCSK, ISO 42001 Lead Auditor) and publicly brand-forward (Forbes, AICPA recognition), making him a credible early validator whose endorsement carries weight with startup founders.
pitch_note: Raymond -- Decrypt promises SaaS startups certification 50% faster, and the biggest drag on that promise is clients showing up with messy AWS environments. LoxeAI is an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner built for lean startups: I'd love 30 minutes to have you run it against a sandbox AWS account and tear apart the findings as an auditor. If it holds up to your standard, your pre-audit pipeline gets a simple play: 'run this scan first -- it gets you ~80% ready before fieldwork starts,' which means cleaner evidence, fewer exceptions, and faster engagements for Decrypt.
